story: As a Super Admin, I want to create a company workspace with its name, industry, size band, contact person and default language, so that a new member company is onboarded in minutes.
acceptance_criteria: Workspace created with a unique slug; appears in the companies list with status Invited; the action is in the audit log.
behaviour: Workspace creation, unique slugs, industry/size/language and audit.

story: As a Super Admin, I want to invite the Company Admin by email, so that the company can start without my help.
acceptance_criteria: Invitation email in the workspace language with a link valid for 7 days; resend and revoke available; status moves to Onboarding when accepted.
behaviour: Seven-day single-use invitations, resend/revoke and localised protected outbox.
gaps: Live email delivery is optional and not validated.

story: As an invitee, I want to accept the invitation, set my password and choose my language, so that I can enter my workspace.
acceptance_criteria: Password policy of 12 characters or more enforced; language saved to the user; the onboarding wizard opens on first entry.
behaviour: Invitation acceptance, password policy, saved language and onboarding entry.
gaps: Invited accounts now open the wizard on first login; seeded demo accounts intentionally bypass that first-run flag.

story: As a Company Admin, I want to invite colleagues as Members, so that the people who know each area can contribute.
acceptance_criteria: Invite by email with role Member; remove a member; pending invitations listed with resend.
behaviour: Member invitations, pending list, resend and membership removal.

story: As any user, I want sign-in, sign-out, password reset and an idle timeout, so that my account stays safe.
acceptance_criteria: Reset link valid for 1 hour; session ends after 12 hours idle; repeated failed sign-ins are rate-limited and logged.
behaviour: Login/logout, hashed tokens, password reset, idle expiry and database failed-login limiting.
gaps: No independent penetration test.

scope_reason: Explicitly included v1 or supporting capability
story: As an admin, I want multi-factor authentication with an authenticator app, required for admin roles, so that admin accounts are protected.
acceptance_criteria: Enrolment forced at first sign-in for Super Admin and Platform Admin; recovery codes issued; MFA status shown in the users page.
behaviour: Authenticator enrolment, codes, hashed recovery codes and verification.
gaps: Local demo bypass is visible and enabled; production rejects this configuration.

story: As the platform, I must keep every workspace's data isolated, so that no company ever sees another's.
acceptance_criteria: Every query is scoped by workspace on the server; automated tests prove cross-workspace requests are refused; retrieval indexes are partitioned per workspace.
behaviour: Workspace-scoped API, records, vectors, files and relationships.
gaps: Security assurance is limited to the recorded test set.

scope_reason: Explicitly included v1 or supporting capability
story: As a Company Admin, I want to grant a named Coordinator read or comment access, so that our advisor is prepared before meetings.
acceptance_criteria: Grant and revoke from workspace settings; the grant is in the audit log; the Coordinator can read and comment but not edit.
behaviour: Named Coordinator grants/revocation and shared-profile read/comment checks.
gaps: Document/workflow-specific Coordinator sharing remains unavailable.

story: As any user, I want to switch the interface between Japanese and English, so that I work in my own language.
acceptance_criteria: Interface, emails and AI replies follow the user's language; a user can ask the AI for one reply in the other language.
behaviour: Persisted JA/EN switch, AI language and localised invitation/reset templates.
tests: browser Japanese language toggle and font asset
gaps: Some statuses, domain content and secondary labels remain English.

story: As a Super Admin, I want to deactivate and reactivate a workspace, so that a company that leaves the programme loses access without losing data.
acceptance_criteria: Deactivated users cannot sign in; data is kept for the retention period; reactivation restores everything unchanged.
behaviour: Workspace deactivation/reactivation enforced by access checks; data retained.

story: As a Super Admin, I want a companies list with status, profile completeness, use-case count and last activity, so that I see who needs attention.
acceptance_criteria: Statuses Invited, Onboarding, Active, Dormant (no activity for 30 days), Deactivated; filter, sort and CSV export.
behaviour: Companies, calculated dormancy, filtering, sorting in API order, completeness/counts and CSV.
tests: browser Admin dashboard, company records and audit
gaps: Name, completeness and activity sorting are exposed; broader sorting combinations are not independently tested.

story: As a Super Admin, I want a company record with the shared profile summary, users, workflow and document counts and open requests, so that I can prepare a conversation.
acceptance_criteria: Shows only sections the company has shared; counts never expose content; links to the feedback and requests from that company.
behaviour: Shared confirmed sections and aggregate counts without private content.

story: As a Super Admin, I want a portfolio dashboard, so that I can port on the programme.             comp use aggr sett
acceptance_criteria: Counts by status; onboarding funnel (invited, accepted, profile approved, first workflow done); weekly active anies; industries; most-chosen cases; feedback sentiment; all egated and respecting sharing ings.
behaviour: Status, funnel, weekly activity, industry and sentiment aggregates.
tests: browser Admin dashboard, company records and audit
gaps: Most-chosen-use-case chart and precise profile-approval event definition require completion.

story: As a Platform Admin, I want to manage the use-case library, so that content improves without a deploy.
acceptance_criteria: Create and edit use cases with Japanese and English fields, stage, entry point, horizon, autonomy level and data needed; draft, review, published states; version history.
behaviour: Platform editor, bilingual fields, states, version snapshots and Operator approval gate.
gaps: Draft seed content is not approved Atomic Loops material.

story: As a Platform Admin, I want to manage workflow templates and question banks, so that discovery improves over time.
acceptance_criteria: Steps, questions, branching rules and outputs editable in both languages; publish creates a new template version; running workflows keep their version.
behaviour: Not built in this phase.
gaps: Deferred to v1.1.

story: As a Super Admin, I want a feedback inbox, so that every piece of feedback is seen and answered.
acceptance_criteria: All feedback with type, page and a reference to the AI output; statuses New, In review, Addressed; tags; reply to the user; export.
behaviour: Feedback inbox, tags/reply/status service and CSV.
gaps: Tag controls are not exposed in the simple UI.

story: As a Super Admin, I want an audit log of admin actions and of any Operator access to company data, so that access is accountable.
acceptance_criteria: Immutable entries with actor, action, target and time; filter by actor, company and date; retained for 1 year.
behaviour: Database trigger blocks audit mutation; access/action logs and filtering/search.
gaps: Retention operations and independent tamper review remain production tasks.

story: As a Super Admin, I want an Admin Copilot that carries out admin requests in natural language, so that routine administration takes seconds.
acceptance_criteria: The AI shows the exact action it will take; nothing executes before confirmation; every action is logged; portfolio questions are answered from aggregated data only.
behaviour: Not built in this phase.
gaps: Deferred to v1.1.

story: As a Super Admin, I want to post announcements, so that every company hears about events and deadlines.
acceptance_criteria: Announcement shown on every workspace home; included in the email digest; can be scheduled and withdrawn.
behaviour: Not built in this phase.
gaps: Deferred to v1.1.

story: As a Super Admin, I want to record programmes, events and partners and let the AI match companies to them, so that the connections the Operator makes are systematic.
acceptance_criteria: Deferred to v2; companies opt in to matching; matches are suggestions the Operator confirms.
behaviour: Not built in this phase.
gaps: Deferred to v2.

story: As a Company Admin, I want an onboarding wizard that takes our website, product details and basic facts, so that the AI can start building our profile.
acceptance_criteria: Fields for website URLs, product text, catalogue and photo uploads, employees, revenue band, plants, certifications, industries served and customer types; progress saved; resumable.
behaviour: Resumable basic wizard and text/file/photo upload pipeline.
tests: browser Profile review modal and history
gaps: Wizard does not expose every SRS field; photos have no interpretation.

story: As a Company Admin, I want the AI to read our website and extract what it learns, so that I do not retype what is already public.
acceptance_criteria: robots.txt respected; depth and page limits applied; every extracted fact carries its source URL; live progress; completes within 5 minutes for sites up to 200 pages; a failed fetch shows a clear message and a manual entry fallback.
behaviour: Live/public and offline crawl, robots policy, redirects, limits, source URLs and progress.
gaps: Live-site performance and DNS rebinding cases need broader validation; failure is conservative.

story: As a Company Admin, I want the AI to analyse each product's function, process, customers, differentiators and potential, so that we see our products the way a market analyst would.
acceptance_criteria: One entry per product or product family with provenance and confidence per statement; the user can add, merge, rename or delete products; adjacent applications and potential markets are labelled Inferred.
behaviour: Structured extraction and product add/edit/merge/delete domain endpoints.
tests: live Real multilingual embedding and structured extraction
gaps: Product merge UI is present; deletion UI and per-statement product analysis need further work.

story: As a Company Admin, I want to confirm, edit or reject every fact on the generated profile, so that the profile only holds what is true.
acceptance_criteria: Sections: Overview, Products and services, Markets and customers, Manufacturing capabilities, Supply chain and partners, Competitive position, Potential and opportunities, Open questions; each fact shows Stated, Sourced or Inferred and a confidence; rejected facts leave the profile and the AI context; every change is logged with the editor and time.
behaviour: Eight sections, provenance/confidence, confirm/edit/reject and history.

story: As a Company Admin, I want a completeness score and a gap list, so that I know what to answer next.
acceptance_criteria: Score per section and overall; each gap names the workflow or question that would fill it; the home page shows the top three gaps.
behaviour: Deterministic required fields, per-section/overall score, top gaps with question/template links.
tests: browser English login and workspace redirect
gaps: Completeness rules are documented defaults, not Operator-approved scoring.

story: As a Member, I want facts I state in chats, answers and documents to flow into the profile after review, so that the profile keeps up with what we tell the AI.
acceptance_criteria: Proposed facts queue with provenance; the Company Admin confirms or rejects; per-fact history with before and after values.
behaviour: Workflow facts and explicit chat-to-profile proposals with review and history.
gaps: User messages now enqueue automatic fact capture; document-wide automatic capture and extraction quality need further validation.

scope_reason: Explicitly included v1 or supporting capability
story: As a Company Admin, I want to re-run the website analysis, so that the profile follows changes to our site.
acceptance_criteria: A diff of new, changed and removed facts is shown; confirmed facts are never overwritten without review.
behaviour: Re-analysis creates a new source and preserves confirmed facts.
gaps: Dedicated added/changed/removed fact diff UI remains incomplete.

story: As a Company Admin, I want to choose which profile sections the Operator can see, so that we control what leaves the company.
acceptance_criteria: Default: overview and products summary; changes logged; shared sections carry a "visible to Operator" marker.
behaviour: Default overview/products sharing, settings, visibility rules and audit.

scope_reason: Explicitly included v1 or supporting capability
story: As a Company Admin, I want to export the profile, so that I can send it to a bank or a customer.
acceptance_criteria: DOCX and PDF in Japanese or English; the export carries the as-of date and the provenance legend.
behaviour: Japanese-font PDF and DOCX profile exports with date and provenance legend.
gaps: Per-fact alternate-language translation exists; whole-profile translated export remains incomplete.

story: As the platform, I must treat website and document content as data, never as instructions, so that a crafted page cannot change the AI's behaviour.
acceptance_criteria: Instruction-like text found in sources is ignored and flagged on the source; a red- team test set of injected pages passes before each release.
behaviour: Source instruction separation, suspicious source quarantine, private-address blocking.
gaps: Regex quarantine is not comprehensive; full adversarial golden set remains required.

story: As a Company Admin, I want the AI to propose the first workflows once our profile exists, so that we know where to start.
acceptance_criteria: Proposals: Company discovery, one Product deep-dive per main product, Market and product-market fit, Manufacturing and AI readiness; each with a rationale, the number of questions and uploads involved; the user starts, defers or dismisses each.
behaviour: B1-B4 initial proposals and product-specific deep dives; start/defer/dismiss.
gaps: AI rationale generation is queued per profile; rationale relevance is not yet reviewer-scored.

story: As a Member, I want a workflow to be a clear sequence of steps with a status and an owner, so that I always know what is next.
acceptance_criteria: Step types: question set, upload request, AI analysis, review and approval, output document; statuses Not started, In progress, Waiting for review, Done, Skipped; owner and optional due date per step.
behaviour: Generic step types/statuses, owner/due-date fields and versioned templates.
gaps: Owner/due-date editing UI needs expansion.

story: As a Member, I want the AI to ask questions in small, adaptive sets, so that answering feels like a conversation rather than a form.
acceptance_criteria: 5 to 10 questions per set; follow-ups depend on earlier answers; answer by text, voice or upload; "I don't know" and "assign to a colleague" available; answers become Stated facts in the review queue.
behaviour: Five-question sets, text answers, unknown/assignment and proposed Stated facts.
gaps: AI generates five bilingual follow-ups after the first five answers, up to ten total; live relevance scoring and upload answer interpretation remain unvalidated. Voice deferred.

story: As a Company Admin, I want to see a workflow as a stepper and as a dependency view, so that I understand what each step feeds.
acceptance_criteria: Stepper with progress; dependency view shows which profile sections, documents and use cases each step feeds and which steps wait on which.
behaviour: Stepper and simple dependency/feed display.
gaps: Detailed profile/document/use-case dependency graph requires expansion.

story: As a Member, I want every workflow to have its own chat, so that I can ask the AI about the step I am on.
acceptance_criteria: Messages carry the workflow context; the AI can mark a step done or move to the next one from the chat after confirmation.
behaviour: Own linked chat and version-checked confirmed transitions.

story: As a Company Admin, I want to create my own workflow from a template or by describing a goal, so that the AI works on what matters to us.
acceptance_criteria: The AI drafts the steps from the goal; the user reorders, adds, removes and assigns steps before starting.
behaviour: Not built in this phase.
gaps: Deferred to v1.1.

story: As a step owner, I want reminders and the ability to pause and resume, so that workflows do not stall silently.
acceptance_criteria: Notification when a step waits on me; weekly digest of open steps; pause and resume keep all answers.
behaviour: Not built in this phase.
gaps: Deferred to v1.1.

story: As a Company Admin, I want a completed workflow to deliver its outputs and propose what comes next, so that momentum continues.
acceptance_criteria: Outputs produced as defined by the template (profile updates, a document, use-case candidates); next workflows proposed with rationale.
behaviour: B1/B3 complete into a findings document and confirmed profile updates.
gaps: Template-specific analyses and automatic next-proposal rationale need completion.

scope_reason: Explicitly included v1 or supporting capability
story: As a Member, I want to turn any chat into a workflow, so that a good conversation becomes structured work.
acceptance_criteria: "Turn this into a workflow" drafts steps from the conversation; the user edits before starting.
behaviour: Confirmed chat-to-B1 workflow draft path is implemented.
gaps: General AI step drafting and editing remain deferred.

story: As a Member, I want a list of chats I can search, pin, rename and archive, and to start a chat blank, from a template, from a workflow or from a document, so that I find and start conversations quickly.
acceptance_criteria: List sorted by last activity; search across titles and content; a chat started from a workflow or document opens with that context attached.
behaviour: Thread creation, pin/rename/archive and workflow/document context.
tests: browser Chat creation and context controls
gaps: Message-content search and archived-thread recovery UI remain incomplete.

story: As a Member, I want replies that stream in, with formatting and citations, and actions on every essage, so that I can use what he AI says.
acceptance_criteria: Streaming starts within 2 seconds at p95; markdown and tables render; citations link to profile facts, sources or web pages; actions: copy, feedback, save to knowledge base, turn into document, turn into workflow, propose to profile.
behaviour: Real SSE, Markdown/tables, citation context, copy/save/document/workflow/profile actions.
gaps: Two-second p95 not established; streamed text needs stronger claim validation.

story: As a Member, I want to see and control what context the AI uses, so that I trust its answers.
acceptance_criteria: Context panel lists the profile sections, sources and workflow in use as toggles; the AI states when it answers without the profile.
behaviour: Real profile/source/workflow toggles and profile-off notice.
tests: browser Chat creation and context controls
gaps: Profile section-level toggles are now exposed in the context panel; dedicated per-section browser assertions remain to add.

story: As a Member, I want to talk to the AI by voice, so that I can use it on the floor or while driving.
acceptance_criteria: Push-to-talk and hands-free modes; Japanese and English recognition; optional spoken replies; transcript saved as the message text; works on a phone browser.
behaviour: Not built in this phase.
gaps: Deferred to v1.1.

story: As a Member, I want to attach files in a chat, so that the AI can read a drawing, a price list or a report.
acceptance_criteria: PDF, images, spreadsheets, Word and PowerPoint up to 25 MB per file; the attachment can be saved as a source.
behaviour: 25 MB PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/text/image uploads; parsing of selectable text.
gaps: Image/scanned interpretation deferred by user.

scope_reason: Explicitly included v1 or supporting capability
story: As a Member, I want suggested prompts based on our situation, so that I know what the AI can do next.
acceptance_criteria: Suggestions drawn from open gaps, waiting steps and newly relevant library use cases; dismissible.
behaviour: Gap-based suggestions from home API and sample chat prompts.
tests: browser English login and workspace redirect
gaps: Waiting-step/library-based suggestions and dismissal need completion.

story: As a Company Admin, I want facts we state in chat to be captured for the profile, so that nothing we say is lost.
acceptance_criteria: The AI proposes recognised facts to the review queue with the message as source; nothing enters the profile without confirmation.
behaviour: Explicit message-to-fact proposal, source reference and Company Admin review.
gaps: Automatic user-message capture now runs as a background job; a mocked regression verifies proposed-only writes. Live capture quality remains unvalidated.

scope_reason: Explicitly included v1 or supporting capability
story: As a Member, I want to share a chat with colleagues and export it, so that the team can build on it.
acceptance_criteria: Share with members; export as Markdown or PDF; a shared chat shows who said what.
behaviour: Chat Markdown/PDF export and shared-with metadata.
gaps: Explicit colleague sharing UI and per-chat visibility enforcement need completion.

story: As a Super Admin, I want a monthly token budget per workspace, so that costs stay predictable.
acceptance_criteria: Default set in admin settings; the workspace sees a notice at 80% and a clear message at the limit; the Super Admin can raise it.
behaviour: Atomic reservations, calendar-month usage, 80% state and admin limit changes.
gaps: Home displays the 80 percent warning; the boundary has a backend reservation test but not a dedicated browser assertion.

story: As a Member, I want long chats to keep working, so that a conversation can run for weeks.
acceptance_criteria: Older messages are summarised into the context; the summary is visible in the context panel.
behaviour: Bounded history, queued summary and visible summary area.
gaps: Summaries now use older turns and a revision-valid prior summary. Long-duration preservation and quality are not validated.

story: As a Member, I want to add files and web pages as sources, so that the AI knows what we know.
acceptance_criteria: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, images, text and URLs; OCR for scanned Japanese PDFs; statuses Processing, Ready, Failed; automatic tags; 1 GB per workspace in v1, configurable.
behaviour: File/URL ingestion, tags/statuses, quotas and embeddings.
tests: live Real multilingual embedding and structured extraction
gaps: Japanese OCR is explicitly deferred; image records are preview-only.

story: As a Member, I want to open a source and see what the AI extracted, so that I can check and clean it.
acceptance_criteria: Extracted text, AI summary and detected facts shown; re-index available; deleting a source removes it from retrieval within one minute.
behaviour: Extraction/summary, re-index and immediate retrieval exclusion on deletion.

story: As a Member, I want to generate a document from a prompt and a template, so that a first draft takes minutes.
acceptance_criteria: Template or free prompt; context chosen from profile, selected sources and a workflow's answers; language and length chosen; the request is saved for re-use.
behaviour: Prompt/template selection, context API, language and saved request.
tests: live Real Japanese document generation and PDF export
gaps: Length is selected in the UI; explicit source/workflow picker UI needs completion.

scope_reason: Explicitly included v1 or supporting capability
story: As a Member, I want to approve an outline before the full draft, so that the document has the structure I need.
acceptance_criteria: Outline shown first; sections can be added or removed; each section can be regenerated on its own.
behaviour: Outline stored before generation and available in draft editor.
gaps: Section-specific regeneration and formal outline editing are incomplete.

story: As a Member, I want an editor with AI actions on selected text, so that I finish the document without leaving it.
acceptance_criteria: Rich text; rewrite, shorten, expand, translate between Japanese and English, insert profile facts, build a table from sources; comments; versions with compare and restore.
behaviour: Rich text, AI rewrite/shorten/expand/translate/table actions, fact insertion, comments, version compare/restore.
gaps: Formatting/table fidelity across rich editor and all exports is not fully preserved.

story: As a Member, I want to export and share a document, so that it reaches banks, customers and the Operator.
acceptance_criteria: DOCX, PDF and Markdown export; share with members and, if granted, the Coordinator.
behaviour: DOCX/PDF/Markdown and local workspace downloads.
gaps: Explicit member/Coordinator sharing controls need completion.

story: As a Member, I want to save a finished document as a source, so that later chats and documents build on it.
acceptance_criteria: One action adds the document to the knowledge base and indexes it; the source shows its origin.
behaviour: Save document with origin/version and enqueue indexing.

story: As a Platform Admin, I want to maintain document templates, and as a Company Admin to save our own, so that drafts match how we write.
acceptance_criteria: Platform templates in both languages; a company template saved from any document; templates versioned.
behaviour: Not built in this phase.
gaps: Deferred to v1.1.

story: As a Member, I want every statement in a generated document to show whether it is sourced, so that I know what to verify.
acceptance_criteria: Sourced statements link to the source; unsourced statements carry an "AI assumption, verify" marker; the export can include or exclude the markers.
behaviour: Citation checks, conservative uncited-paragraph markers and export marker toggle.
tests: live Real Japanese document generation and PDF export
gaps: Every-statement citation/assumption accuracy is not established.

story: As a Member, I want to translate a whole document between Japanese and English, so that one draft serves both audiences.
acceptance_criteria: Workspace glossary keeps product and process terms consistent; the translation becomes a new version.
behaviour: Not built in this phase.
gaps: Deferred to v2.

story: As a Company Admin, I want planning canvases pre-filled from our profile, so that planning starts from what the AI already knows.
acceptance_criteria: Business model canvas, product- market fit board (segment, problem, product, alternatives, evidence, status), go-to-market plan, three-year financial outline, export readiness; each cell editable; AI fills carry provenance.
behaviour: Not built in this phase.
gaps: Deferred to v1.1.

story: As a Company Admin, I want the AI to challenge a canvas, so that weak assumptions are found before a bank or a customer finds them.
acceptance_criteria: A "challenge" action lists the weakest assumptions, why, and the evidence that would resolve each.
behaviour: Not built in this phase.
gaps: Deferred to v1.1.

story: As a Member, I want each hypothesis to link to its evidence, so that we track what is proven.
acceptance_criteria: Links to sources, chats and workflow answers; statuses Untested, Validated, Invalidated.
behaviour: Not built in this phase.
gaps: Deferred to v1.1.

story: As a Company Admin, I want an action plan derived from the canvases, so that planning turns into tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Tasks with owner and due date; progress shown on home.
behaviour: Not built in this phase.
gaps: Deferred to v1.1.

story: As a Company Admin, I want to export the planning pack, so that it can be presented or submitted.
acceptance_criteria: One document from all canvases in the chosen language, through the document studio.
behaviour: Not built in this phase.
gaps: Deferred to v1.1.

story: As a Company Admin, I want a short explainer of how AI fits a factory, so that I can talk about it with my team.
acceptance_criteria: Covers the five audit stages, the three outcomes of a report, the four steps (descriptive, predictive, prescriptive, autonomous), the L0 to L5 ladder, the three horizons and the value principles (measured before modelled, targets derived, haircuts applied, overlaps combined); each concept has one example; Japanese and English; readable in under 15 minutes.
behaviour: Bilingual draft method overview, stages, ladder, horizons and principles.
gaps: Three report outcomes and examples require Atomic Loops source material.

story: As a Member, I want a factory map I can click through stage by stage, so that I see where AI applies in a plant like ours.
acceptance_criteria: Seven operational stages (inward, warehouse, kitting, assembly, final inspection, packaging, logistics) plus lanes for planning and supply chain, maintenance, quality, R&D and product discovery, and sales and product-market fit; selecting a stage shows typical human operations, software systems and example use cases; stages indicated by our profile are highlighted.
behaviour: Seven-stage factory map, supporting lanes and draft descriptions.
gaps: Profile-derived highlights and complete stage-specific operations/systems need completion.

story: As a Member, I want each library use case as a card I can search and filter, so that I can compare options.
acceptance_criteria: Card fields: title, stage, problem solved, how it works, data needed, systems touched, entry point (software only, camera based, machine IoT), horizon, autonomy level, prerequisites, what good looks like; value shown only as observed ranges with no client named; Japanese and English; filters by stage, entry point, horizon and level.
behaviour: 44 bilingual baseline cards, enriched draft fields, search and filters.
gaps: Draft fields are generic and require domain/Japanese review; no invented measured value ranges.

story: As a Company Admin, I want the AI to recommend use cases that fit our profile, so that we do not read the whole library.
acceptance_criteria: Ranked list with a rationale per use case tied to profile facts and the readiness gaps it would face; "add to my use cases" in one click; feedback on every recommendation.
behaviour: Transparent rule-ranked recommendations tied to confirmed machining/inspection facts; add is idempotent.
gaps: AI matching, richer gaps and recommendation-specific feedback need completion.

story: As a Member, I want to define our own use case with the AI's help, so that ideas from the floor become something we can plan.
acceptance_criteria: Wizard: problem, stage, who is affected, how the data is captured today (paper, spreadsheet, system, sensor), systems involved, expected outcome and KPI; the AI drafts a one-page charter, classifies the step and autonomy level and lists prerequisites and data needs; the user edits and saves.
behaviour: Custom wizard, editable fields and AI charter document action.
gaps: AI level classification and full charter journey not independently validated.

story: As a Company Admin, I want a readiness check per use case, so that we know what has to exist before it can run.
acceptance_criteria: Four dimensions (data, process, people, systems) with 3 to 5 questions each; a readiness rating and gap list; the level the use case needs against where we are today.
behaviour: Not built in this phase.
gaps: Deferred to v1.1.

story: As a Company Admin, I want a road map board, so that our use cases are sequenced the way the method says.
acceptance_criteria: A 2x2 of business impact against readiness to deploy with quadrants Quick wins, Strategic bets, Momentum builders and Later; a programme view by horizon (H1 to H3) on a multi-year line; drag and drop; dependencies shown as "needs the data created by"; export as a document.
behaviour: Drag/drop quadrants, horizon timeline, dependencies API and roadmap export.
gaps: Four readiness dimensions and year are editable; dependency editing UI and dynamic programme layout need completion.

story: As a Company Admin, I want a self-service lite assessment, so that we can prepare the ground before a full audit.
acceptance_criteria: Five stages in self-service form: KPI alignment questions, a pain-point interview in chat, stage-by- stage capture of each line or machine with data, human and material lanes, a document checklist, and a preliminary readiness summary with recommended quick wins; every output is labelled preliminary.
behaviour: Not built in this phase.
gaps: Deferred to v1.1.

story: As a Company Admin, I want to request an Atomic Assessment from inside the platform, so that the next step is one click away.
acceptance_criteria: Form pre-filled from the profile, use cases and readiness; routed to Atomic Loops and the Operator; statuses Requested, Scheduled, In progress, Report delivered visible to the company.
behaviour: Not built in this phase.
gaps: Deferred to v1.1.

story: As a Member, I want learning content per stage, so that I understand each use case before I commit to it.
acceptance_criteria: Short explainer, an anonymised example and the "what we need from the plant" list per stage; a glossary in both languages.
behaviour: Draft stage learning/glossary foundation.
gaps: Complete approved bilingual teaching material unavailable.

story: As any user, I want to rate any AI output in one click and say why, so that the AI improves on what matters to us.
acceptance_criteria: Thumbs up or down, a reason from a short list and free text on every message, profile fact, document, recommendation and charter; non- blocking; stored with a reference to the output.
behaviour: Thumb ratings with target references on implemented outputs.
gaps: Reason/free-text capture is global; per-output detail flow needs completion.

story: As any user, I want a feedback widget on every page, so that I can report anything, anywhere.
acceptance_criteria: Categories: bug, idea, confusing, wrong, praise; free text; optional screenshot; page, role and language captured automatically.
behaviour: Global category/text widget, screenshot upload, role/page/language capture.
gaps: Screenshot is an uploaded image; no OCR.

story: As a Member, I want to report a wrong fact where I see it, so that the profile is corrected quickly.
acceptance_criteria: The fact is marked Disputed; the correct value is requested; the item goes to the review queue and the inbox.
behaviour: Fact dispute, correction payload, review and inbox.
gaps: Dispute correction UI is minimal.

story: As any user, I want to see what happened to my feedback, so that giving it feels worthwhile.
acceptance_criteria: Statuses Received, In review, Addressed; the reply from the Operator or Atomic Loops shown under the item.
behaviour: User feedback history, statuses and Operator reply.

story: As a Super Admin, I want feedback analytics, so that I can report on satisfaction and spot problem areas.
acceptance_criteria: Volume, positive rate, by feature and by company in aggregate, trend over time; export.
behaviour: Analytics API by date/company/feature and CSV.
gaps: Detailed trend/feature charts not exposed in UI.

story: As a Platform Admin, I want feedback and the related output in the evaluation set, so that prompts and models are tuned on real cases.
acceptance_criteria: Available only where the company's consent setting allows; never used to train third-party models; personal data removed before use.
behaviour: Consent gate, local redaction, review acknowledgement and evaluation export.
gaps: Automated redaction is not guaranteed anonymisation; reviewer must inspect preview.

story: As a Super Admin, I want a short quarterly in-app survey, so that we measure satisfaction consistently.
acceptance_criteria: Three questions, once per quarter per user, dismissible; results on the dashboard.
behaviour: Not built in this phase.
gaps: Deferred to v1.1.

story: As any user, I want notifications in the app and by email digest, so that I act when something waits on me.
acceptance_criteria: Events: invitation, step waiting on me, document ready, feedback answered, announcement; per-user preferences; daily or weekly digest.
behaviour: Notification centre, preferences, daily/weekly database-backed digests and outbox.
gaps: Some event hooks and optional SMTP delivery are not complete.

story: As a Company Admin, I want an activity feed, so that I see what the team and the AI changed.
acceptance_criteria: Facts confirmed, documents created, use cases added, workflows started and completed, with actor and time.
behaviour: Not built in this phase.
gaps: Deferred to v1.1.

story: As a Company Admin, I want workspace settings, so that we control our data and our team.
acceptance_criteria: Name, logo, default language, members, Coordinator access, sharing with the Operator, data retention, export of all data (documents, profile, chats as JSON and Markdown in a ZIP) and a deletion request.
behaviour: Name/language/instructions/retention/members/grants/sharing, ZIP and deletion request.
gaps: Logo upload is present; complete approved deletion execution remains incomplete.

story: As a new user, I want a guided tour and help, so that I am productive on day one.
acceptance_criteria: First-run tour, help articles in both languages, contextual tips, an onboarding checklist on home that ticks itself off.
behaviour: Tour, contextual first steps and gap checklist.
tests: browser English login and workspace redirect
gaps: Full bilingual help articles and automatic completed checklist are incomplete.

story: As any user, I want to search across everything in the workspace, so that I find what the AI and the team produced.
acceptance_criteria: Profile, chats, documents, sources and use cases searchable with filters by type and date.
behaviour: Not built in this phase.
gaps: Deferred to v1.1.

story: As the platform, I must record consent, so that personal data and feedback are used lawfully.
acceptance_criteria: Terms and privacy notice accepted at first sign-in; consent to Operator visibility and to feedback use are explicit settings with their change history.
behaviour: Invitation terms acceptance, distinct feedback-use consent and change records.
gaps: Seed-account first-login notice and legal review are incomplete.

story: As any user, I want every interface element in Japanese and in English, so that I never meet an untranslated screen.
acceptance_criteria: Navigation, buttons, forms, tables, charts, dashboards, emails, error messages and help exist in both languages; Japanese is the default for company workspaces; the language toggle is on every page; an automated test fails the build on any missing string; screenshots of every page in both languages are reviewed before release.
behaviour: 226 paired JA/EN resource keys and persistent language switch.
tests: browser Japanese language toggle and font asset
gaps: Some hard-coded statuses/secondary content are still English.

story: As a Member, I want the AI to reply in my language and switch when I ask, so that the chat feels native.
acceptance_criteria: Replies follow the user's language; a chat can be switched to the other language; a mixed- language message (a Japanese question with English product names) is handled; a single reply in the other language is available on request.
behaviour: User/request language passed to real model; mixed-script inputs supported.
gaps: Human quality review still required.

story: As a Company Admin, I want every generated output in the workspace language and available in the other language on demand, so that the same material serves Japanese and overseas readers.
acceptance_criteria: Profile, facts, documents, charters, recommendations and the road map are generated in the workspace language; a one- click version in the other language is produced; the workspace glossary and Appendix F keep terminology consistent across both.
behaviour: Workspace-language documents, selected-text translation and glossary foundations.
tests: live Real Japanese document generation and PDF export
gaps: One-click alternate versions for every output are not complete.

story: As a Company Admin, I want the AI to read our Japanese bsite and documents rrectly, so that the profile is ilt from what we actually blish.
acceptance_criteria: Japanese encodings, vertical text in PDFs where feasible and Japanese OCR are handled; facts are stored in the source language and shown with a translation labelled "translated" when the viewer's language differs.
behaviour: Selectable Japanese PDFs/HTML and original text; Japanese embedding model.
gaps: OCR deferred; vertical layout/encoding corpus and translation labels require expansion.

story: As a Platform Admin, I want the library and the explainer content to be bilingual by construction, so that nothing reaches a company in one language only.
acceptance_criteria: Every use case, stage and explainer has Japanese and English fields; publishing is blocked until both exist; the Operator's reviewer approves the Japanese wording (OQ-10).
behaviour: Paired library fields, draft states and version-aware Operator publication gate.
gaps: Actual Operator Japanese approval not provided.

story: As any user, I want dashboards and charts labelled in my language with local formats, so that numbers read correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Axis labels, legends, statuses and tooltips in both languages; numbers, dates and currency formatted per locale, yen formatted per locale; ISO dates in admin exports.
behaviour: Locale-formatted UI dates, numeric basics and ISO exports.
tests: browser Japanese language toggle and font asset
gaps: All chart/status/currency formatting needs comprehensive validation.

scope_reason: Explicitly included v1 or supporting capability
story: As a Member, I want search and retrieval to work across languages, so that an English source answers a Japanese question.
acceptance_criteria: A query in either language retrieves sources in both; citations show the source's original language.
behaviour: Multilingual embeddings and tenant-scoped semantic retrieval.
tests: live Real multilingual embedding and structured extraction
gaps: Japanese-to-English relevance corpus is not yet evaluated.

story: As a Member, I want voice to work in Japanese and in English st without choosing first, so that I can just speak.
acceptance_criteria: Language detected per utterance; transcript ored in the spoken language; spoken replies in the user's language (v1.1).
behaviour: Not built in this phase.
gaps: Deferred to v1.1.

story: As a Japanese user, I want typing and reading to behave correctly, so that the interface feels like a Japanese product.
acceptance_criteria: IME composition handled in every field, including the chat composer; Japanese line- breaking rules; fonts with full JIS coverage on web and in exports.
behaviour: IME-safe chat Enter handling, bundled Japanese font and CJK PDF wrapping.
gaps: Full JIS typography and current/previous browser matrix not verified.

story: As a Super Admin or Coordinator, I want to read a company's shared content in my own language, so that I can prepare without a translator.
acceptance_criteria: Shared sections and feedback shown in the viewer's language with a "translated by AI" marker where the original differs; exports keep the original language unless a translation is requested.
behaviour: Not built in this phase.
gaps: Deferred to v1.1.

story: As any user, I want notifications and emails in my language, so that nothing arrives in a language I do not read.
acceptance_criteria: Every template exists in both languages; the recipient's language setting decides; the invitation email follows the workspace default until the user chooses.
behaviour: Bilingual invitation/reset and notification digest templates.
gaps: All event wording and recipient-language combinations need review.
